description: Attach an existing onboarding file (relative path) as the workspace's onboarding document. Stores it in .cpfs/config-mcp.json (onboarding.path + legacy onboardingPath). Parity with the extension's attachOnboarding command (file picker → MCP arg).

rel_path.description: Relative path to the onboarding file (e.g. 'docs/ONBOARDING.md').

name: cpfs_attach_onboarding
